page.title: Recipe
page.purpose: Show one meal so it can be read, understood, scaled, planned, and cooked: header actions, Recipe, Nutrition, and Notes tabs, and Reading and Recipe map views driven by the same method graph as cooking and print.

priorities.statement: Title, times, servings, and Start cooking are visible together at the top on every device.
Ingredients and the numbered method read side by side on wide screens and stacked on phones, in the same revision and step order as cooking mode.
Changing servings changes displayed quantities only until the person applies it to a planned meal.
The Recipe map shows how ingredients become the meal, including split uses and joins, with a readable alternative.
Nutrition names its basis, provenance, and unknowns, and compares against targets only with explicit scope.
A draft without ingredients or method says so plainly and offers Edit.

states.description: The Recipe tab in Reading view for the current or pinned revision.
First read of the page's data; stable skeletons reserve the layout so nothing shifts on arrival, and no sample food is shown as saved data.
Some contributing data is unknown or could not be read; what is missing is named rather than shown as zero.
Displayed data is older than its freshness window; its age is shown next to it.
A write is in flight; the affected control shows a busy state and says why it is unavailable, and success appears only after the durable save.
The request failed; the reason and the next action are stated, pending edits are kept, and nothing is edited against a fake empty account.
Input was rejected; the offending field is identified next to it and every other edit is preserved.
The client cannot reach the API; cached data, locally pending actions, and server-confirmed saves are distinguished and unsupported actions say why.
The recipe id does not resolve in this workspace; a not-found state offers Back to meals and reveals nothing about other workspaces.
The Recipe map view: ingredient allocations as rows and actions as columns in their own scroll region.
The Nutrition tab: per serving or selected yield, provenance, unknowns, contributors, and scoped target comparisons.
The Notes tab: personal notes, source and attribution, revision details, and recorded feedback.
Servings differ from the recipe yield; quantities are scaled for display with Reset, and Apply to planned meal when opened from an occurrence.
A draft shows No ingredients added yet and No method added yet with Edit.
A ready-to-eat item deliberately has no cooking steps; the primary action is Add to week or Log meal.
An archived recipe opened from history; the pinned revision stays readable and cookable.
The header image is generated serving inspiration and carries that caption.
The recipe has no usable image; the header uses the minimal treatment without an empty frame.

claims.statement: Start cooking is the one filled primary action in the header.
On phones the title, servings, and Start cooking are reached without scrolling past the photo.
Scaled servings change displayed quantities only; the recipe and plan change only through Apply to planned meal.
Reading, map, print, and cooking mode show the same revision, step ids, and scaled quantities.
The Recipe map has a readable text alternative, and unlinked ingredients are labelled rather than dropped.
A wide map scrolls inside its own region; the page never scrolls sideways.
Generated imagery is captioned Serving inspiration; ordinary photos carry no such label.
An incomplete draft says what is missing and offers Edit instead of an empty cooking screen.
A ready-to-eat item does not offer Start cooking or manufactured steps.
Unknown nutrient contributions are perceivably different from known zeros.
Tabs, the view toggle, serving controls, header actions, and map cells are keyboard reachable with correct tab semantics.
Light and Evening change palette and artwork only; the recipe, servings, dates, occurrences, layout, and actions are identical.
